high_level_description: The image depicts an urban street scene featuring a large billboard mounted on the side of a brick building. The billboard is rectangular and white with a black border. It prominently displays a black shoe with a mesh-like upper and a strap across the top. The brand name "ALAIA" is visible on the inside of the shoe. The building itself has a red brick facade with some decorative elements along the roofline. There are windows with white frames, and some air conditioning units are visible on the exterior walls.
